description: This Java source file defines a command handler class 'CloseFixedDepositAccountCommandHandler' for closing fixed deposit accounts within the Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface, handles commands of type 'FIXEDDEPOSITACCOUNT CLOSE', and utilizes the 'DepositAccountWritePlatformService' to perform the closure operation.

classes.name: CloseFixedDepositAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to close fixed deposit accounts, encapsulating the logic to invoke the deposit account write platform service.

methods.name: CloseFixedDepositAccountCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with the required deposit account write platform service dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the 'close fixed deposit account' command by delegating to the deposit account write platform service.
